<issue_description>
Heap-use-after-free in Zend/zend_closures.c: zend_closure_free_storage can end up invoking zend_string_release on a function name that has already been freed, causing subsequent reads of freed heap memory (seen via zend_string_release and zend_objects_store_del). This use-after-free during closure/object destruction can cause crashes, memory corruption and may be exploitable for information disclosure or arbitrary code execution.
